campaign: K3 full-12 compact union exact width-two discriminator
question: Can the already-proven exact width-two MMVQ seam reuse one full-12 compact payload over M_e=245 while remaining byte-identical and materially faster than rowwise execution?
reason_for_candidate: Width-eight was validly closed as non-exact. Width two is a distinct retained exact seam, including the earlier live M64 pair2 parity result; this run does not retry a failed width-eight arm.

fixture.requested_masks: the same eight deterministic 1..8-slab masks, repeated in fixed order

arms_in_fixed_order: 245-row rowwise compact teacher versus one full-12 payload reused over width-two chunks

correctness_gate.outputs: byte-identical for all 245 rows and five tail rows
correctness_gate.dispatch: MMVQ launches greater than zero and MMQ launches equal zero
correctness_gate.payload: candidate authoritative weight H2D equals one full-12 payload

performance_gate.primary_metric: matched rowwise teacher_ns divided by 245-row candidate_ns
performance_gate.go: all correctness gates pass and speedup is at least 1.6x
performance_gate.no_go: any correctness failure or speedup below 1.6x

abort_conditions: wrong physical device or platform profile
any correctness, dispatch, or accounting failure

interpretation_boundary: A GO earns a default-off fixed-width-two layer-major executor, not a live prefill speed claim. Physical storage and full model state/logit parity remain separate gates.
